explanation: Bread, Noodles, Biscuit, and Pancake are all staple foods predominantly made from flour. Quinoa is a pseudocereal typically cooked and consumed as whole grains, not primarily processed into flour for its common culinary uses.

category: Status of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Colossus of Rhodes, Lighthouse of Alexandria, and Temple of Artemis at Ephesus are all among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World that have been destroyed and no longer stand. The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the original Seven Wonders that still largely exists today.
Mile, Gallon, Pound, and Inch are all common units of measurement belonging to the Imperial system. Kilometer is a unit of length from the Metric system.
